exposure: chronic endometritis cured by standard antibiotic therapy
cohort: The study included 833 patients in their first frozen embryo transfer cycles with single euploid embryo transfer, categorized by the presence or absence of chronic endometritis.
finding: Patients with chronic endometritis cured by standard antibiotic therapy had a significantly higher rate of early pregnancy loss compared to those without chronic endometritis in subsequent frozen embryo transfer cycles, although live birth rates were comparable.
